summary: Create Watchpost Whiskey as an American blended whiskey at 42.5% ABV. Reuse the established Westland distillery Entity and do not copy the age of one blend component into the Bottle's stated age.

dbOutcome.summary: At capture, the production add-bottle flow created Bottle 44299 as Watchpost Watchpost with unsupported stated age 8 and new Westland Distillery Co. Entity 365683 instead of using the marketed Whiskey expression and established distillery Entity.

provenance.notes: Added from the exact failed image add-bottle flow and its persisted production image. The label shows Watchpost, An American Blended Whiskey, 42.5% Alc/Vol, and Westland Distillery Co.; it does not state an age. Official Watchpost copy says the blend contains 8-year-old Westland American Single Malt, which does not make the complete blended product age-stated. This fixture preserves the pre-creation local state. Production Bottle 44299 later stored that component age as statedAge 8 and retained duplicate Entity 365683; those catalog defects are not the expected classifier identity.
